format: RFC3339 UTC Z; six digits zero-pad existing precision, not extra measurement precision

notification.postgres_storage: timestamp with time zone; write strings with explicit offset, never bind a DateTime that loses offset
notification.writes: Both the one-recipient and read-all commands keep WHERE read_at IS NULL; Eloquent notification/recipient creation preserves offsets too
notification.first_read: Persisted first read is immutable on subsequent mark calls. GET never marks, repairs, clamps or relabels an existing future instant.
notification.historical_bad_value: 2026-10-20T13:49:36+00:00 remains that instant, equivalent to 2026-10-20 20:49:36 in Vietnam; no repair authorized

sources.SCAN.time: scan_events.created_at or scan_record_events.created_at after existing canonical dedup
sources.session.startedAt: persisted started_at only; null if column/value absent
sources.session.endedAt: persisted ended_at only; null if column/value absent
sources.latestEvent.occurredAt: created_at of the selected latest event across the complete permitted source; never last page row

history.aware_storage: Inspect actual PostgreSQL source column type and preserve the recorded instant; normalize before UNION, filtering, sort, cursor and serialization
history.naive_storage_candidate: Fixed Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh wall-clock convention follows existing canonical scan writers now() and prior P08/P23 app-local storage contract, independent of display/filter warehouse and PG session timezone
history.legacy_provenance_gate: The supplied historical scan has no recorded offset. Its actual creation/seed timezone is not proven by the stored string, UI list, POSTED status, source link or present runtime timezone. This source rule is a candidate for that row until its owner confirms provenance. Do not deploy as proof that its real event occurred at either UI time.
history.date_filter: Existing server date-only query semantics remain unchanged. Normalize query bounds to the same internal UTC key as source expressions; never shift a date-only input or filter one FE page.
history.cursor: P08 keeps its opaque transport and existing error policy but binds the source timestamp revision in its fingerprint. Old source-rule cursors are rejected, not silently reinterpreted. P23 page scope also includes the timestamp revision.
history.permission: Existing actor/session/warehouse/source guards, totals, dedup and P08 PII redaction remain authoritative
history.null: Preserve null, including absent start/end and posted_at; do not derive a timestamp from status, doc_no, current lookup or now

frontend: Parse one RFC3339 instant and render Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Equivalent Z/+00:00/+07:00 instants render identically. Do not add/subtract seven hours or replace the offset on unchanged wall-clock text.
acceptance: OPEN until owner source-provenance confirmation and authenticated approved TEST write/read plus Android/web observations; deployment, local regressions and unauthenticated guards are not full runtime/UI acceptance
